card.name: Creature Swap
card.officialText: Each player chooses 1 monster they control and switches control of those monsters with each other. Those monsters cannot change their battle positions for the rest of this turn.

behavior: Normal Spell is activated only by the active physical representative during an open Main Phase
both teams must control at least one monster at activation; each team chooses exactly one controlled monster only at resolution
choices are non-targeting and validated atomically; an invalid choice cannot partially swap
control changes simultaneously without Special Summon or new card identity
UID, physical owner, position, face-up state and combat counters are preserved
both monsters receive positionLockedThrough for the current turn; an existing longer lock is preserved
the Spell moves from hand to an available backrow zone on activation and to its physical owner's GY after resolution
no-monster-at-resolution and negation resolve without a swap
activationId replay protection persists through JSON; inventory is conserved

limitations: Adapter permanece isolado e não está integrado ao resolver v9; a carta não fica disponível em decks.
Testes usam estado TagDuel em memória e engine compilado; não simulam gateway/guild Discord real.
A escolha simultânea é recebida como par atômico pelo adaptador; a UI de coleta/privacidade ainda depende da integração central.
